hero.title: Your business deserves to be
hero.subtitle: Cosmic Studio builds websites and apps for craftspeople, associations and independents. A clear site, built to be found on Google, and one person who stays on after launch.

audience.title: People with a trade, and no time to learn a second one.

artisans.title: Craftspeople
artisans.description: Carpenter, plumber, hairdresser, caterer. A page that says what you do, where, and how to reach you, and that people find when they search for your trade nearby.

associations.title: Associations
associations.description: Choir, sports club, collective. Event calendar, memberships, news: everything to make your activities known and bring in new members.

independents.title: Independents starting out
independents.description: Therapist, consultant, photographer. A professional site from day one to get known, and a price that grows with your business.

why.title: Wix and WordPress do the job. Until the day they don't.
why.lead: These tools are handy at first. Then you need a plugin, then an update breaks the page, then the bill goes up. We write the code ourselves: the site is yours, it is fast, and it grows without starting over.

ownership.title: You own it
ownership.description: Your content and your domain name are yours from day one. The code is handed over at the end of the minimum subscription period, or earlier for a transfer fee.

fast.title: Fast and easy to find
fast.description: No heavy theme, no plugins: pages that load quickly on a phone, which Google rewards.

person.title: A person, not a ticket
person.description: You talk to Matthieu, who knows your site because he built it.

grows.title: It grows with you
grows.description: A page today, a shop or an app tomorrow, on the same foundation.

process.title: Four steps. No surprises.
process.subtitle: From the first conversation to launch day, you always know where your project stands.

discovery.label: T-3 · Meeting
discovery.title: We talk
discovery.description: Twenty minutes on the phone or over a coffee in Geneva or Annecy. Your trade, your customers, what the site needs to do for you.

design.label: T-2 · Mockup
design.title: You see it before you pay
design.description: A mockup of your home page, with your colours and your words. Free, with no commitment: you decide afterwards.

build.label: T-1 · Build
build.title: We build
build.description: Two to six weeks depending on the project. You follow progress on a private link, you comment, we adjust.

launch.label: T-0 · Launch
launch.title: Live, and we stay
launch.description: Launch, a hands-on walkthrough together, then hosting, backups and small changes as the months go by.

apps.title: The studio also builds its own products.
apps.lead: That is where we test tools before offering them to clients. What we learn on our apps ends up in yours.

daily_fortune.name: Daily Fortune
daily_fortune.description: A short message every morning to start the day well. Our first app published on the App Store and Google Play.

studio.title: A developer in Geneva, not a platform.
paragraphs: I'm Matthieu Compérat. I grew up in Duingt, on the shores of Lake Annecy, and I'm based in Chêne-Bougeries. I have been building websites and apps for about fifteen years, first for large companies, then for people whose first names I know. Cosmic Studio is that second choice.
You call, I answer. You write, you get a reply the same day. The site I deliver, I know exactly how it works.

cta.description: Tell us about your business in a few lines. We get back to you within 24 hours, with questions, not an automated quote.
cta.freeMockup: Still unsure? Ask for your <link>free mockup</link>.
cta.title: Let's make your business shine.
